content.description: Illustration of coolant reservoir/expansion tank with FULL and LOW level markings

items.heading: CHECK COOLANT LEVEL
items.text: The coolant level should be between the LOW and FULL lines. If low check for leakage and add coolant up to the FULL line.

content.description: Illustration showing hand checking radiator cap and filler hole

items.heading: CHECK COOLANT QUALITY
items.text: There should not be any excessive deposits of rust or scales around the radiator cap or radiator filler hole, and the coolant should also be free from oil. Replace the coolant if excessively dirty.

content.description: Illustration showing radiator with drain cocks marked at two locations

items.heading: REPLACE ENGINE COOLANT
steps: (a) Drain the coolant from radiator and engine drain cocks. (Engine drain is at right rear of engine block.)

(c) Fill system with coolant.
Use a good brand of ethylene-glycol base coolant, mixed according to the maker's directions.
